head: 912b6ac7f94d415969bc6cefa0e2e15540457ed5
summary:
SL-113 does what it promised, checked on HEAD 912b6ac on this PC. The display is now 1920x1080 at 100%, with a 1032 DIP work area.

**Tests and window cases**
- Full suite: 1111/1111.
- T-013 and T-014 pass.
- The existing stopped-ending and tree window cases pass: L-001..L-004, T-010, T-011, T-012, T-001, T-004, and T-003. T-003 can be measured here now because the work area is taller than the default window.
- Q-114: WindowMutants -Mutant All killed 16/16 mutants on their pinned lines, including NoTreeAtLeast, NoListAtLeast, TreeAtLeastRolled and NarrowAtLeastCells.
- Q-027: the rules harness gave 175 rows, all as recorded, exit 0, engine 0ccf00f. RuleCases C-001 and C-003 pass. Fitness holds 102 rules.

**Real-data checks**
- Stopped tree on a real folder: I ran the published exe on C:\Program Files and stopped at Git\.
  - 357 tree rows: 316 unfinished, each drawing the store's bound in full; 3 final, drawing the plain rolled figure; 38 not read.
  - 652 ancestor checks, all 'at least'.
  - 54 list rows: 19 marked with figures equal to the tree's, 35 not read.
  - 0 violations.
  - Every bound read 0 bytes, which Q-292 expects for a Stop during listing.
- Stops during size checks on real data: a temporary Core test I added and then deleted ran five Stops inside the probes on C:\Program Files\dotnet (13,190 entries).
  - The store matched a parent-chain walk of the tree exactly: 0 mismatches.
  - Final folders matched the completed scan: 0 differ.
  - No bound was above the completed scan: 0.
  - 0 failed ancestor checks.
  - List marks were correct.
  - The completed scan had 0 unfinished entries.

**O-036 (marks carry up to the root)**: verified on the uneven-depth test tree with a temporary test, deleted afterwards. Over 94 listing Stops and 7 size-check Stops, Unfinished and AtLeast equal the walk on every entry. All 2,447 ancestor checks were unfinished, with chains up to 6 levels deep.

**Criterion 6 diff**: the only existing expectations that moved are the two list header strings Q-290 allowed. The other edits add T-013 and T-014 to the case lists and rename the AtLeastFigures type in tests.

**The one failure**: the SL-100 bug project failed 6/29 on its first run, in the window-activation focus checks F06 and F12. It passed 29/29 on four reruns. This slice does not touch that code, so I filed it as a flaky test (backlog), not a defect.

**Not covered here**
- Nonzero 'at least' figures drawn on screen: the window hook cannot stop during size checks, so these are checked in Core only.
- 150% scaling and larger text: the Size and On disk cells have 0.74 DIP to spare at 100%.
- Windows 10.
- A completed scan of the whole C: drive.

criteria.criterion: 1. Draw a stopped tree row's figures for a listed folder with a pending file below it (Stop during listing, cutoff 0)
criteria.how: T-013 C1: all 12 unfinished rows draw 'at least '+AtLeast in both cells, unclipped at 102 DIP. Same on real C:\Program Files: 316 unfinished rows, 0 violations.

criteria.criterion: 2. Draw a stopped tree row's figures when the rolled figure differs from AtLeast (b-listed 212 KB rolled vs bound 0)
criteria.how: T-013: none of the 12 rows whose bound differs from the rolled figure draws the rolled figure. The TreeAtLeastRolled mutant fails exactly those lines in -Mutant All.

criteria.criterion: 3. Draw a stopped tree row's figures for a file whose own size check is pending
criteria.how: T-013: b-listed\b1.bin draws 'at least 0 bytes' in both cells. Real Program Files run: 222 file rows unfinished, all drawing the bound.

criteria.criterion: 4. Mark every ancestor, up to and including the root, of a row drawing 'not read yet' or 'at least'
criteria.how: T-013 C2: 419 ancestors checked, root draws 'at least'. Real run: 652 ancestor checks. Temporary ragged-tree check: 2,447 ancestors all Unfinished.

criteria.criterion: 5. Mark an ancestor whose only unfinished descendant is unread (no pending file below)
criteria.how: StoppedTopLevelTests.AFolderWithNoFileBelowIsMarkedThroughAnUnreadFolderBelowIt passes in the full suite. The ragged-tree check matched the walk (which counts unlisted folders) on every entry over 94 listing Stops.

criteria.criterion: 6. Show a final folder with no qualifier (a-empty, b-listed\empty, c-prefix, b-listed\denied)
criteria.how: T-013 C3: all 4 store-final rows draw the rolled figures with no word, and the named folders are among them. Real dotnet size-check Stops: 424-1833 final folders, all equal to the completed scan.

criteria.criterion: 7. Show a folder the Stop never listed: 'not read yet', no figure
criteria.how: T-013/T-010 pass. Real Program Files run: 38 not-read rows draw 'not read yet' with empty cells; 35 list rows not read, unworded.

criteria.criterion: 8. Mark the stopped list's rows like the depth-1 tree rows
criteria.how: T-013 C4: 2 marked rows by name, bound and 'N files' equal to the store and the tree cells. NoListAtLeast mutant killed. Real run: 19 marked list rows equal the tree cells.

criteria.criterion: 9. Redraw the list at the ending when a tick already showed the final unmarked snapshot
criteria.how: StoppedTopLevelTests requires a new snapshot object whenever any row is marked (passes), so ShowFinalTopLevel's reference skip cannot hide the marks. T-013 and the real run show marked list rows at the ending. Not observed in a window: a run where a tick had certainly shown the final snapshot first.

criteria.criterion: 10. Stop during size checks: watermark mid-store
criteria.how: StoppedTopLevelTests.AStopInTheSizeChecksMarksOnlyTheRowsWithAPendingCheck passes. Real data: five Stops inside probes on C:\Program Files\dotnet, 0 mismatches against the walk and the completed scan. No window case: the hook has no trigger inside the size checks.
T-013 run 2: 268 rows, the store reports none unfinished, no 'at least' in any row or hook line. The completed dotnet reference scan had 0 unfinished entries and MarksAtLeast false.

criteria.criterion: 12. End a scan with no store to mark (Count 0, RootUnreadable, Refused, TopLevel null)
criteria.how: ANoStoreToMarkIsReturnedAsItIsAndNeverRead passes in the full suite. MarksAtLeast requires Store.Count > 0 and gates both surfaces.

criteria.criterion: 13. Open a 100k-child folder in a stopped tree with at least 5,000 unread children and marked rows on screen
criteria.how: T-014: 9,992 unread, 8 realized rows drawing 'at least'; cold 105.5 ms, warm 2.8-3.3 ms, all under 500 ms.

criteria.criterion: 14. Read the stopped headers at the default 880 px window
criteria.how: T-013: tree header exact, its figures sentence (ends at 101) drawn within 107 characters. List header equals the reworded $StoppedListHeader. L-001/L-004/T-010 pass with only the two constants changed (Q-290).

planned.evidence: Tree rows the store reports unfinished draw Size and On disk as 'at least '+AtLeast (T-013: 12 rows; real C:\Program Files: 316 rows, 0 violations). File count is marked where it is drawn, on the stopped list's figures line ('in at least N files', equal to AtLeast.Files), which is Q-293's decided reading; tree rows have no file-count column.

T-013 walks 419 ancestors to the root, all 'at least'. Real run: 652 ancestor checks, 0 bad. O-036 check on the uneven-depth tree: 2,447 ancestors all Unfinished; real dotnet size-check Stops: up to 79,203 ancestor checks, 0 bad.

T-013: 4 store-final rows draw rolled figures with no word. Real run: 3 final rows equal the store's figures, unmarked. Real dotnet size-check Stops: 424-1833 final folders, all equal to a completed scan (0 differ).
T-013 C4: the stopped list's 2 marked rows carry the same bound as the depth-1 tree rows. Real run: 19 marked list rows match the tree cells, 35 not read and unworded. NoListAtLeast mutant killed.
T-014: cold open of m-big (100,000 children, 9,992 unread, 8 marked rows realized) 105.5 ms; warm 2.8-3.3 ms; all under 500 ms. T-012 and T-003 also pass (cold 103.2 and 129.7 ms).

T-013 run 2 (completed, same tree): 'at least' nowhere. Existing cases L-001, L-002, L-003, L-004, T-010, T-011, T-012, T-001, T-003, T-004 pass. The diff moves only the two header constants Q-290 allowed. WindowMutants -Mutant All 16/16.

obligations.evidence: Ragged-tree check (NotListedBelowTests.RaggedTree), the tree the code review said was missing. A temporary xUnit test, deleted afterwards, made Stops before and during each of 49 listing calls (47 non-empty stores each) and at each of 7 probe calls. store.Unfinished equalled UnfinishedTests.Oracle, a parent-chain walk that marks every ancestor of a pending file or unlisted folder, on every entry. AtLeast equalled the walk's bound on every unfinished folder. Every not-listed or unfinished entry had all ancestors Unfinished: 1,038 + 1,038 + 371 checks, chains up to 6 deep. Also on real data: five size-check Stops on C:\Program Files\dotnet, 0 mismatches against the walk, 0 failed ancestor checks. In the window: T-013 checked 419 ancestors and the C:\Program Files run checked 652, all 'at least'. This holds for the scanner's depth-first, one-SetChildren-per-block order, the condition SL-111 attached.

not_reached: Nonzero 'at least' figures drawn in the window. The hook has no trigger inside the size-check pass, and every Stop during listing gives bound 0. Nonzero bounds were checked in Core on real data (C:\Program Files\dotnet) only, and drawn on screen only through the TreeAtLeastRolled mutant.

150% scaling and Windows' larger-text setting. The 102 DIP cells hold 'at least 1,023 bytes' (101.26 DIP) with 0.74 DIP to spare at 100% here and at 125% at build. A person must look, or Q-301's SetRootDpi follow-up must check it.
At the 560 px minimum width the tree header draws 48 of its characters, so the sentence about the figures is cut. The design claims only the default 880 px.

A completed scan of the whole C: drive confirming no not-listed mark survives completion (the blocked spike). Criterion 6 on a real drive rests on MarksAtLeast. Completed scans of C:\Program Files\dotnet and the T-013 tree show 0 unfinished.
Windows 10: no machine here has it.
StoppedTopLevel's cost inside the App on a 5M-entry stopped store. Spike 126 measured 10.2 ms cold in a Release harness, not in the App's ending.
The tick-then-ending order (a timer tick showing the final unmarked snapshot before ShowOutcome) was not observed in a window. Only the new-object contract is tested.
